jobs.title: Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT Utrecht & Haarlem - Jobbird.com
jobs.description:
Werk aan innovatieve IT-oplossingen die Nederland in beweging houden. Maak impact, groei mee en bouw aan de digitale toekomst van NS.

Jij zorgt voor de mobiliteit van Nederland
Veel ontwikkel-mogelijkheden
Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden

Daarom wil je als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werken

Je werkt aan technologie die direct bijdraagt aan betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig treinvervoer.
Je ontwikkelt en verbetert een bedrijfskritisch MES-platform op het snijvlak van IT, OT, techniek en productie.
Je krijgt veel ruimte om slimme oplossingen te ontwerpen voor de modernisering van onze treinen in Haarlem, dicht op de operatie.

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT

Als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werk je aan het Manufacturing Execution System (MES) binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Dit bedrijfskritische platform, gebaseerd op AspenTech, ondersteunt de productie- en onderhoudsprocessen waarmee treinen worden gemoderniseerd. Daarmee heeft jouw werk direct impact op de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van onze treinen.

Deze functie is anders dan een klassieke fullstack ontwikkelaarsrol. Je werkt niet alleen aan software, maar ook aan configuratie, integraties, procesontwerp en technische continuïteit binnen een operationele productieomgeving. Je schakelt met operators, productieondersteuning, functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars en andere collega’s om gebruikersvragen te vertalen naar robuuste technische oplossingen.

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbetert bestaande oplossingen en helpt verstoringen structureel op te lossen. Daarbij werk je met onder andere SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en MES-processen. Je denkt mee over de technische roadmap, migraties, beveiliging en de toekomst van het MES-landschap. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat belangrijk is voor de modernisering van treinen én voor de dagelijkse operatie in de fabriek.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

Je ontwikkelt, configureert en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen het AspenTech MES-platform.
Je vertaalt productie- en onderhoudsprocessen naar robuuste, schaalbare en praktisch toepasbare technische ontwerpen.
Je werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en optimalisaties binnen het MES-landschap.
Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en lost technische verstoringen structureel op, soms direct in contact met de fabriek.
Je neemt een leidende rol in technische ontwerpkeuzes en bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en veiligheid van oplossingen.
Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers zoals operators en productieondersteuning.
Je denkt mee over technische migraties, contracten, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen op de roadmap van het MES-platform.
Je ondersteunt bij releases, migraties en technische verbetertrajecten.
Je deelt kennis binnen het team en helpt collega’s technisch verder, zodat de afhankelijkheid van enkele kennishouders kleiner wordt.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt terecht in het MES-team binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Hier worden treinen vernieuwd, verbeterd en toekomstbestendig gemaakt. Binnen die omgeving speelt digitalisering een steeds grotere rol. Het MES-platform ondersteunt collega’s op de werkvloer bij productie- en onderhoudsprocessen en vormt daarmee een belangrijke schakel tussen IT, OT en de dagelijkse operatie.

Het team bestaat uit een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars, een technisch applicatiebeheerder en een functioneel beheerder. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het MES-platform stabiel blijft draaien én meegroeit met de behoefte van de fabriek. Je werkt in een omgeving waar techniek, softwareontwikkeling en productie samenkomen. Dat vraagt om nauwkeurigheid, eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de rust om ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag werk je aan een strategische verbetering van het platform, de andere dag help je een verstoring oplossen die direct impact heeft op de productie. Juist die combinatie van IT, techniek en operatie maakt deze functie interessant voor een ontwikkelaar die graag dicht bij de praktijk werkt.

Dit zijn de functie-eisen

Je bent een ervaren IT-professional of softwareontwikkelaar die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische aanpak. Je vindt het interessant om complexe systemen te doorgronden en krijgt energie van het slimmer maken van productieprocessen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, denkt goed na over je aanpak en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen.

Verder herken je jezelf in het volgende:

Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van technische informatica, software engineering, industriële automatisering of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt ruime ervaring als software engineer, systems engineer, IT engineer of ontwikkelaar binnen complexe en bedrijfskritische IT-landschappen.
Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met MES-systemen, productieomgevingen en industriële automatisering.
Ervaring met AspenTech MES, ASM of vergelijkbare MES-platformen is een sterke pré.
Je hebt goede kennis van SQL, databases en systeemintegraties.
Je hebt ervaring met JavaScript, TypeScript en bij voorkeur enige kennis van .NET.
Je hebt ervaring met API’s, koppelingen, data-integraties en technische architecturen.
Je kunt zelfstandig verstoringen analyseren, prioriteiten bepalen en tot een structurele oplossing komen.
Je communiceert duidelijk en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen, van ontwikkelaars tot gebruikers op de werkvloer.
Je bent stressbestendig, verandergericht en zelfbewust: je blijft rustig bij onverwachte situaties en durft keuzes te maken met oog voor kwaliteit en samenwerking.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Voor deze functie onder meer:

Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand op basis van schaal 60 en een 36-urige werkweek. Je inschaling is afhankelijk van je werkervaring.
De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden, in overleg.
Een 36-urige werkweek.
3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
Bij goed functioneren krijg je na een jaar een vast contract.
Gratis treinreizen in de 2e klas. Reizen in de 1e klas kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.
Je gezin reist gratis mee in de daluren.
144 uur wettelijk verlof op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, plus extra verlof afhankelijk van je leeftijd. Dit is minimaal een week.
De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet-christelijke feestdagen.
Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
Een keuzeplan met onder andere een fietsenplan, extra pensioenopbouw of extra vakantiedagen.

Wil je meer weten? Bekijk dan onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en cao.

Solliciteren naar deze baan

Wil jij als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT werken aan software, integraties en productieprocessen die direct bijdragen aan de modernisering van treinen? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Binnen enkele minuten ontvang je een automatische sollicitatiebevestiging. Binnen 2 weken reageren wij op jouw sollicitatie.

In onze werving nemen we bij NS ook Learning Agility mee, omdat we het belangrijk vinden om niet alleen te kijken naar wat je al kunt, maar ook naar hoe je leert, ontwikkelt en meebeweegt met verandering. Zo maken we samen een duurzame match.

Je kunt je sollicitatie richten aan Jeroen van den Berg, Corporate Recruiter IT.

Heb je nog vragen over het sollicitatieproces?
Mail dan naar Karin van onze frontoffice via . Heb je liever telefonisch contact? Bel dan met onze frontoffice op 088-6713666.

Goed om te weten

Een achtergrondonderzoek, waaronder een VOG (Verklaring omtrent Gedrag), maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. Dit omvat ook het tekenen van een integriteitsverklaring en geheimhoudingsverklaring.
We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt. Dit zie je terug in ons aannamebeleid. Lees hier meer.
Met deze vacature werven wij zelf onze nieuwe collega. Dit is géén oproep voor acquisitie. De functie kan niet op interim basis worden vervuld. Bekijk daarvoor onze inhuurpagina.

Op NS kun je rekenen

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. De kernwaarden van NS zijn open en betrouwbaar. Wij gaan voor resultaat en willen vooruit.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Sollicitatie ontvangenWe hebben jouw sollicitatie goed ontvangen en laten je binnen 2 weken weten of we met je verdergaan in deze procedure.
(Online) sollicitatiegesprekWe nodigen je uit voor een sollicitatiegesprek met de recruiter en teammanager. Het gesprek vindt digitaal plaats via Microsoft Teams of bij ons op kantoor.
VervolggesprekWe nodigen je uit voor een vervolggesprek bij ons op kantoor.
Arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek Digitaal bespreken we het arbeidsvoorwaardelijke aanbod en heb je de mogelijkheid om vragen te stellen.

jobs.description:
Dutch Fluency Required

We do not offer visa sponsorship (including HSM) now or in the future.

Dit ga je doen

Als Test Engineer bij Astek zorg jij voor testautomatisering die écht werkt. Je kiest de juiste tools, bouwt robuuste testoplossingen en integreert die soepel in bestaande ontwikkel- en releaseprocessen. Jij houdt het tempo hoog zonder concessies te doen aan kwaliteit. Je beweegt makkelijk mee in nieuwe teams en organisaties. Je schakelt met developers, analisten en andere QA‑specialisten, maar pakt net zo goed zelfstandig de lead wanneer dat nodig is. Dankzij jouw ervaring zie je snel waar verbeterkansen liggen en weet je precies hoe je die omzet in resultaat. We zoeken iemand die gewend is aan consultancy of detachering en stevig genoeg staat om complexe omgevingen aan te kunnen. Je hebt ruime ervaring met moderne testautomatisering, CI/CD en API‑testen. Agile voelt voor jou als de natuurlijke manier van werken: snel schakelen, slim samenwerken en continu verbeteren. Kort gezegd: jij brengt de expertise, wij de omgeving waar je impact maakt.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

Je bouwt schaalbare testautomatisering die teams helpt om met vertrouwen te releasen
Je kiest en adviseert over de juiste tooling, frameworks en aanpak voor elke klantomgeving
Je integreert geautomatiseerde tests in CI/CD‑processen, zodat kwaliteit continu wordt bewaakt
Je analyseert risico’s en verbetermogelijkheden en vertaalt die naar concrete acties
Je werkt nauw samen met developers, analisten en QA‑specialisten om kwaliteit vroeg in het proces te borgen
Je draait mee in Agile‑teams en brengt een kwaliteitsmindset in elke sprint
Je deelt kennis en versterkt teams, zodat testautomatisering duurzaam landt
Je schakelt snel in nieuwe omgevingen en weet direct waarde toe te voegen

Dit breng je mee

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als Test Engineer
Je hebt ruime ervaring met Tosca, Cypress, Playwright of Robot Framework
Ervaring binnen de consultancy of detachering (pré)
Ervaring binnen Agile-, Scrum- en/of SAFE-omgevingen
Ervaring met CI/CD pijplijnen
Een HBO/WO diploma

Jouw weg naar een baan

Telefonische/Virtuele kennismaking met een Recruiter
2e gesprek met een Business Unit Manager
Een aanbod wat past bij jouw kennis en ervaring

Dit bieden wij

Een vast contract vanaf dag één
Een competitief salarispakket afgestemd op jouw ervaring -> wil je alvast een beeld hebben? Neem dan een kijkje naar onze salarismeter
28 vakantiedagen met de mogelijkheid om er 5 bij te kopen
Hybride werken, je werkt 1 tot 2 dagen op kantoor bij de klant
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling
Flexibele mobiliteitsvergoeding voor auto, OV of fiets – of leaseauto
Een cafetariaregeling voor aankopen die jou in je werk ondersteunen, denk aan een telefoon, laptop etc. (50% belastingvoordeel)
Onbeperkt opleidingsbudget (We vergoeden alle opleidingen en trainingen die bijdragen aan jouw professionele ontwikkeling)
Samenwerking met OpenUp: toegang tot gecertificeerde psychologen, workshops en ondersteuning voor jou en je familie
Ieder kwartaal uitjes met collega's en een jaarlijkse internationale trip (Zo zijn we o.a. al geweest in Dublin, Mallorca, Ibiza, Valencia, Barcelona, Lissabon en dit jaar gaan we naar Marbella!)

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
About The Company

Scheidt & Bachmann GmbH is a renowned leader in the development of innovative mobility solutions that connect people and goods seamlessly. With a history spanning over 150 years, our company specializes in creating sustainable, reliable systems for transportation infrastructure, including ticketing, parking, fueling, and public transport management. As a family-owned enterprise, we prioritize values such as trust, reliability, and teamwork, fostering an environment where innovation thrives. Our commitment to shaping the future of mobility is reflected in our continuous pursuit of technological excellence and sustainable development, making us a trusted partner in the global mobility industry.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior C# / .NET Softwareentwickler (m/w/d) for industrial applications to join our Operational Technology team in Mönchengladbach. This role offers an exciting opportunity to influence the digital transformation of our production and logistics processes. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and modernizing applications that are integral to our manufacturing and logistical operations. Your expertise will help translate complex requirements into practical, sustainable software solutions, supporting our goal of optimizing operational efficiency and digital integration across various systems.

Qualifications

Completed education or university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, or a comparable technical field.
Extensive experience in software development using C# and .NET frameworks.
Proficiency in database technologies, particularly Oracle and MS SQL Server.
Hands-on experience with APIs, web services, and system integration projects.
Understanding of production, logistics, and business processes within industrial environments.
Excellent command of the German language, good English skills, and valid work authorization for the EU.
Self-reliant, responsible working style combined with strong communication skills and team orientation.

Responsibilities

Contribute to shaping the digital future of our production by developing and modernizing applications tailored for manufacturing and logistics.
Design and implement software solutions that are practical and effectively utilized in operational environments.
Create integrations between ERP, production, warehousing, and third-party systems to streamline workflows.
Translate complex technical requirements into sustainable, scalable software solutions that meet business needs.
Advance our API and integration landscape through continuous development and innovation.
Evaluate emerging technologies and drive digitalization initiatives to enhance operational capabilities.
Act as a technical point of contact for internal departments and colleagues, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing.

Benefits

Secure, permanent employment within an innovative and established company that values diversity and equality.
Flexible work arrangements, including options for remote work, part-time schedules, and a healthy work-life balance.
Additional perks such as bike leasing, access to Urban Sports Club, and a childcare allowance.
Modern company restaurant offering diverse meal options to support your well-being.
Structured onboarding process complemented by a Buddy-Programm to ensure a smooth start and integration.
Continuous professional development through targeted training and development programs.
Competitive salary and a collegial work environment characterized by mutual respect and recognition.

Equal Opportunity

Scheidt & Bachmann GmbH is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunities for all employees. We do not discriminate based on gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we actively promote a culture of respect, fairness, and collaboration across all levels of our organization.

jobs.title: Software Architect .NET Banking (all genders)
jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.

DEINE ROLLE

Softwarearchitektur: Du entwirfst zukunftssichere Softwarearchitekturen im .NET-Umfeld für Banken und Finanzdienstleister und verantwortest ihre Umsetzung in komplexen Projekten.
Banking-Modernisierung: Du verbindest klassische Enterprise-Architekturen wie Monolithen, Client-Server-Systeme und On-Premises-Landschaften mit modernen Ansätzen wie Microservices, Containern und eventgetriebenen Architekturen.
Standards & Governance: Du definierst und etablierst Architektur- und Technologiestandards wie Cloud-native, API-First, Security by Design und Domain-Driven Design und berücksichtigst dabei die besonderen Anforderungen des Banking-Umfelds.
Stakeholder-Management: Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen aus Banken und Finanzdienstleistungsunternehmen in tragfähige technische Lösungen und arbeitest eng mit Kundenseite, Fachbereichen und Entwicklungsteams zusammen.
Innovation & Qualität: Du bewertest Trends wie AI-Integration, Serverless, Observability, Zero-Trust-Security und DevSecOps im Hinblick auf sichere, resiliente und zukunftsfähige Banking-Anwendungen.

DEIN PROFIL

Qualifikation & Erfahrung: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation und bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Design und in der Dokumentation komplexer Softwarearchitekturen mit. Idealerweise hast du bereits in Projekten für Banken oder Finanzdienstleister gearbeitet.

Entwickle und pflege unsere aktuarielle Systemlandschaft - mit Fokus auf Stabilität, Modernisierung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung zentraler Funktionalitäten
Automatisiere Prozesse für Berechnung, Reporting und Deployment - unter Einsatz moderner Engineering‑Methoden wie CI/CD, automatisiertem Testing und modularen Architekturen

Teamgeist und Freude am gemeinsamen Gestalten

jobs.description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. DEINE ROLLE

Gestalte Testarchitekturen: Entwickle und pflege Testautomatisierungsarchitekturen und stelle die Qualität geschäftskritischer Software sicher.
Implementiere und überwache Tests: Setze Automatisierungslösungen um, integriere sie in CI/CD-Pipelines, generiere Testdaten und führe automatisierte Testfälle aus, dokumentiere Abweichungen und stimme deren Behebung mit dem Entwicklungsteam ab.
Koordiniere Teams und Lasttests: Leite kleine Teams von technischen Testern, implementiere Testszenarien für Lasttests und stelle sicher, dass sie effizient ausgeführt werden.
Berate Stakeholder: Unterstütze User der Fachabteilungen und Entwicklungsteams bei Fragen zur Softwarequalität und Testmaßnahmen.
Unterstütze die Testplanung: Trage durch Schätzungen und Statusberichte zur Planung und Steuerung von Testaufgaben bei.
Arbeite neue Teammitglieder ein: Unterstütze neue Tester:innen bei der Einarbeitung und teile dein Wissen, um den Testprozess kontinuierlich zu verbessern.

DEIN PROFIL

Fachliche Qualifikation: Ein Ausbildungs- oder Studienabschluss in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik bildet deine Basis für diese Rolle.
Testautomatisierung und Programmiersprachen: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Erfahrung in agilen Projekten mit DevOps mit und bist sicher in mindestens zwei Programmiersprachen wie Java, TypeScript, C# oder Python.
Know-how in Automatisierung: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung von Automatisierungslösungen mit Technologien wie Playwright oder Selenium und kannst diese in CI/CD-Pipelines wie Jenkins oder GitLab integrieren.
Testdaten und Umgebungen: Synthetische Generierung von Testdaten und Containerisierung von Testumgebungen, z.B. mit Docker und Kubernetes sind dir nicht fremd.
Schnittstellen: Vertrautheit mit dem automatisierten Test für synchrone Schnittstellen (Client-Server) und asynchrone Schnittstellen (Microservices) wie REST, SOAP, AMQP oder MQTT gehören zu deinem Skillset.
KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
We’re On the Beach! Since 2003, we've been rewriting the rules of how people discover, book, and experience their perfect getaway. What started as connecting people to short-haul beach holidays has evolved into something much bigger - premium beach destinations, long-haul adventures, and vibrant city breaks – and that’s just the beginning of our story.

We send around two million holidaymakers on their dream breaks every year. And we're still growing.

Powered by our deep-rooted entrepreneurial spirit, proprietary tech, curiosity and our incredible people, we’re accelerating - delivering best in class technology, the ultimate holiday app, and experiences that keep our customers coming back for more.

Ready to build the future of travel with us?

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend), you’ll design and build scalable applications, services and platforms across On the Beach.

This is a full-stack engineering position with a stronger emphasis on backend engineering, distributed systems and cloud-native architecture.

Our backend engineers solve a wide variety of problems. You could be working on systems responsible for communicating with external travel suppliers, processing large volumes of hotel inventory and pricing information, powering customer search experiences, or ensuring bookings move reliably through complex transactional workflows.

You’ll work across the development lifecycle and collaborate with engineers, product managers and other technical specialists to design, build, deploy and operate reliable software at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing Day To Day

Designing and building scalable backend applications and services
Developing APIs used by customer-facing applications and internal systems
Integrating with external suppliers and third-party platforms
Building systems that process high volumes of requests and data
Designing distributed and event-driven architectures
Working with asynchronous messaging and streaming technologies
Solving problems around performance, latency, resilience and availability
Improving caching and data-access strategies
Building reliable transactional workflows
Developing applications and services within AWS
Deploying and operating containerised applications
Improving monitoring, alerting and observability
Exploring AI-assisted engineering and modern development tooling

At Senior level, you’ll be expected to understand the wider system rather than only the individual service you are working on.

You should be comfortable considering how systems behave in production, identifying failure scenarios and balancing scalability, resilience, maintainability and delivery speed.

We’re looking for strong full-stack engineers whose experience leans towards backend and platform engineering.

You’ll be a great addition to our team if you have the following skills, knowledge and experience

Strong commercial backend software engineering
C# and .NET or comparable experience building modern backend applications
Designing and developing APIs
Building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures
Developing cloud-native applications, ideally within AWS
Working with messaging, asynchronous processing or event-driven architecture
Designing reliable integrations with external or internal systems
SQL and/or NoSQL data stores
Building scalable systems handling significant traffic or data volumes
Performance optimisation, caching and latency reduction
Designing for resilience and failure
Containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Observability, monitoring and operating production systems
Automated testing and modern engineering practices

We don’t expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our stack. Strong engineering fundamentals and evidence of solving comparable problems at scale are more important than matching every individual tool.

What We’re Looking For At Senior Level

Beyond the technologies themselves, we’re looking for someone who:

Can independently solve complex engineering problems
Thinks about the customer and commercial impact of technical decisions
Understands the trade-offs between speed, quality and long-term maintainability
Can contribute meaningfully to technical and architectural discussions
Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues
Raises engineering standards through collaboration rather than hierarchy
Helps less experienced engineers develop
Is comfortable working in an environment where priorities and problems can change quickly

What To Expect From Our Interview Process

After a call with our Talent Acquisition Team, We will run a 3 stage interview process all on Microsoft Teams, Which will consist of:

Hiring Manager meet & greet - 30 Minutes

Behavioural & ways of working - 60 Minutes

Tech Pairing & System Design - 120 Minutes, broken down into two parts (50 minutes each) with a short break and time for your questions at the end.

We want to make sure everybody has the opportunity to perform at their best. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the interview process please let the Talent Acquisition team know and they will be happy to assist.

Ways of working

Our full time hours are 37.5 per week, but we don't have rigid working hours so you can find the working pattern that's right for you. We have core working hours between 10am - 4pm, so we can collaborate and enjoy the social side of work.

We also have hybrid working so we all work from home and from our Aeroworks office in Manchester City Centre. We operate a remote-first working model, with colleagues meeting in our Manchester office one day every two weeks. Please note that all applicants must be eligible to work full-time in the UK

Our Benefits

We might be biased but we think our colleagues are pretty great. They're the people that have made On the Beach what it is today and continue to make it vibrant and successful tomorrow. That's why we offer a competitive benefits package, known as our Beach Perks, to all On the Beach colleagues.

These Include

25 days holiday plus your birthday off
Generous discount on holidays, plus you will receive 2 extra days annual leave on top of your holiday allowance to use whilst you're away on your On the Beach package holiday
Access to Learnerbly learning platform, plus workshops, courses and professional qualifications
Enhanced maternity, paternity, shared parental leave and adoption pay, plus other family friendly support
Employee Assistance Programme and free access to counselling
Simplyhealth Optimise Health Plan
Company Sick Pay scheme
Regular wellbeing events
Gym discount
Share Incentive Plan (SIP)
Death in Service cover
Onsite subsidised coffee shop
The Sandbox (our very own bar)
Food and drink discounts across a number of venues in Manchester City Centre
Regular social events
Cycle to Work scheme

We're On the Beach! One of the UK's largest online package holiday specialists, with significant opportunities for growth.

The work spans the full stack of what engineering needs to do around a GenAI platform: solving problems natively, backend plumbing, API integrations, MCP server builds, and data connections.

Working in our GenAI platform doesn't always mean writing code. Often it means applying engineering judgement to solve problems natively, designing the right architecture, the right integration, the right data flow, directly within the platform itself. At Senior Engineer level, you'll own your delivery end-to-end. You translate business need into solutions and technical design, and work individually or as part of the team to solve those in the best way at pace.

Strong expertise in at least one modern back-end programming language, such as C#, Java, or C++, with the ability and willingness to learn new technologies as needed.

As the first engineering hire at REGULEX AI LIMITED, you will inherit a live system with real users in regulated firms. What You Will Do

Build and manage a robust multi-tenant infrastructure on Azure, including deployment pipelines, observability, and tenant-specific isolation using PostgreSQL Row-Level Security.
Architect and iterate on the core data asset, normalizing disparate global datasets to create predictive signals for fund allocators across Europe and North America.
Collaborate directly with design partners at FCA-regulated firms to translate feedback into production-ready modules, shipping changes from development to users within hours.

Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.

The Opportunity
. We are looking for an experienced Delivery Manager to take ownership of multiple systems integration workstreams within a complex technology environment.

You don’t need experience of a particular technology stack or sector, but you must have personally owned the delivery of integration projects rather than simply supported them through PMO or governance.

What We’re Looking For. At least 5 years’ hands-on project/delivery management experience specifically within systems integration.

Experience working with middleware or integration platforms within cloud-based environments.
Good practical understanding of APIs, middleware, integration patterns and technical dependencies.
Experience managing integration delivery through the full SDLC.

Strong risk, issue and dependency management skills.

jobs.title: Azure DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About The Company

At IMSERV, we're proud to be one of the UK's leading energy data and metering specialists. We deliver award-winning services to customers across the country, providing specialist metering technology for electricity, gas and water, alongside highly accurate energy data collection services.

About The Role

The purpose of the role is to own the Azure platform on which IMSERV's Astral products are built, tested and run, helping us deliver highly scalable, secure, multi-tenant SaaS software to clients across the globe. You will be one of two DevOps Engineers who together own the path to production: the Azure environments, the CI/CD pipelines, the releases and the security and cost posture of the estate. The pair share the full scope so that no environment, pipeline or release depends on any one individual. This role sits within our Scrum teams, working day to day with Software Engineers, Testers and the Technical Architect. Where they own the code, you own the platform it ships on, through the entire product lifecycle.

Qualifications

Applicants should have at least 5+ years of experience managing production Azure environments, with a strong understanding of App Services, Azure SQL, storage solutions, and networking fundamentals. Proficiency in writing and maintaining CI/CD, build, and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps (YAML) is essential, along with experience in artifact management, controlled build configurations, and pipeline variables. Candidates must be familiar with infrastructure as code tools such as Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform, and possess scripting skills in PowerShell and Azure CLI. A solid grasp of secure-by-default platform design principles, including Azure Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC, and least privilege access, is required. Experience in monitoring, backup, disaster recovery, and incident response for live services, using tools like Application Insights and Log Analytics, is also necessary. Familiarity with Agile SCRUM methodologies and related ceremonies is important, as is a good understanding of SQL Server for managing environment data, refreshes, and safe testing data. Desirable qualifications include Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert), and experience with Azure PaaS services like Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management, Azure Logic Apps, or Azure Data Factory/Synapse/Microsoft Fabric. Knowledge of C#/.NET to read application code and assist with debugging, along with experience consolidating single-tenant deployments into multi-tenant platforms, will be advantageous. Additionally, familiarity with enterprise client security requirements, AI-assisted tooling, and penetration test remediation is beneficial.

Responsibilities

The role involves comprehensive environment management, including provisioning, configuring, and maintaining the Astral environment estate across development, test, UAT/load, and production stages. Ensuring environments are consistent, reproducible, and well-documented through infrastructure as code practices is crucial. Managing environment refreshes and test data in compliance with data protection policies is part of the duties. Building, maintaining, and continuously improving Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines is key, with a focus on artifact management, controlled build configurations, pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. Consolidating individual client pipelines into a unified deployment process as the platform evolves to multi-tenancy is also expected. Deployment planning and execution, including rehearsed rollback procedures and supporting product go-lives, are essential responsibilities, alongside maintaining a clear release calendar. Ownership of security protocols includes secrets and certificate management via Azure Key Vault, managed identities, role-based access control, and platform patching, in collaboration with IT security teams. Monitoring the platform’s health and reliability through observability tools, managing backups, disaster recovery tests, and leading incident response activities are vital for maintaining system stability. Cost management involves monitoring and optimizing Azure spend, right-sizing resources, and reporting on cost drivers. Maintaining up-to-date documentation, runbooks, environment configurations, and knowledge sharing within the team ensures operational resilience. Active participation in Scrum ceremonies, the wider Product Engineering community, and team events promotes collaboration and continuous improvement. Providing prompt support to engineers for environment and pipeline needs is also part of the role.

Benefits

Our employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including 28 days of holiday plus Bank Holidays, and an option to buy or sell annual leave through our scheme. We offer up to a 10% bonus based on performance, an enhanced salary sacrifice pension scheme, and life assurance coverage of up to six times your salary. Our health and wellbeing options include a Simply Health plan with upgrade options and a car salary sacrifice scheme, subject to length of service and terms. Additional perks may include access to various wellness programs and discounts, designed to support a healthy work-life balance and financial security.

Equal Opportunity

At IMSERV, we're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and communities. We believe that a diverse team enhances innovation, collaboration, and service excellence. If you are interested in this role but do not meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Please note that we reserve the right to close this position before the specified closing date.

Brightstar is an innovative, forward-thinking global leader in lottery that builds on our renowned expertise in delivering secure technology and producing reliable, comprehensive solutions for our customers. As a premier pure play global lottery company, our best-in-class lottery operations, retail and digital solutions, and award-winning lottery games enable our customers to achieve their goals, fulfill player needs and distribute meaningful benefits to communities. We have a longstanding commitment to Responsible Gaming (RG) that is engrained within our core business and the products we offer to customers and players worldwide. Brightstar has a well-established local presence and is a trusted partner to governments and regulators around the world, creating value by adhering to the highest standards of service, integrity, and responsibility. Brightstar has approximately 6,000 employees. For more information, please visit www.brightstarlottery.com.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Director of Software Engineering to lead the engineering organization responsible for the development, scalability, and long-term evolution of one of business-critical products within BrightStar’s lottery technology portfolio.

This role combines strategic technology leadership, people management, product delivery ownership, and strong cross-functional collaboration. The successful candidate will be accountable for building and leading high-performing engineering teams, driving predictable delivery of the product roadmap, ensuring technical excellence, and partnering closely with Product, Architecture, Delivery, Operations, Security, and senior business stakeholders.

Ensure secure, resilient, maintainable, observable, and compliant systems

Collaborate with Architecture, Security, Cloud, Operations, and global teams to ensure alignment and successful execution
Serve as a trusted engineering partner to leadership, Product, Operations, Sales, and customers, effectively communicating plans, risks, trade-offs, and progress
Contribute to strategic planning, budgeting, resource allocation, and management of external partners and vendors
Foster an inclusive, accountable, high-performance engineering culture

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or equivalent experience (Master’s/MBA preferred)

Leading Complexity

Job Description

Senior Integration Engineer

We are seeking an experienced API Engineer to design, build, secure, and operate enterprise-grade APIs that integrate cloud platforms with on‑premise banking application suites. The role focuses on developing reliable and scalable integration services, enabling secure data exchange across channels and systems (core banking, payments, fraud, risk, CRM, digital platforms), while meeting stringent regulatory, availability, and security requirements.

You will work closely with solution architects, platform engineers, security teams, and business stakeholders to deliver API products aligned to bank integration patterns, including synchronous REST services and event-driven integrations.

Direct line reporting:

Head of Architecture and Core Banking – Europe.
Accountabilities And Responsibilities

API Design & Delivery

Design and implement RESTful APIs and integration services connecting cloud services to on‑prem banking systems.
Create reusable API patterns for common banking capabilities (customer, accounts, payments, transactions, entitlements).
Define and maintain API contracts (OpenAPI/Swagger), versioning strategies, and backward compatibility.
Deliver APIs that meet performance, latency, availability, and resiliency expectations (e.g., timeouts, retries, circuit breakers).

Security, Compliance & Controls

Implement strong API security controls: OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, JWT validation, request signing, API gateway policies, and rate limiting.
Apply secure coding practices and align solutions with bank security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory expectations (e.g., least privilege, encryption in transit/at rest).
Collaborate with security to support threat modeling, pen test remediation, and secure configuration management.

Cloud–On‑Prem Connectivity & Integration

Build and operate integration flows using enterprise tooling (examples: API gateway, service mesh, ESB/iPaaS, message brokers).
Implement hybrid connectivity patterns such as VPN/ExpressRoute/Direct Connect equivalents, private endpoints, network segmentation, and secure routing.
Integrate with on‑prem technologies (e.g., MQ, legacy services, SOAP where required, databases, batch systems) and modern cloud services.

Observability & Operations

Implement observability: structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, dashboards, and alerting.
Support production deployments and incident triage; conduct root cause analysis and introduce reliability improvements.
Automate CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure/Configuration as Code where applicable.

Engineering Excellence

Write clean, testable code (unit/integration/contract tests).
Participate in code reviews, technical design reviews, and architecture governance.
Document API products and integration runbooks for support and operational readiness.
Experience and Key Competencies:

Knowledge & Experience:

5+ years (adjust as needed) developing APIs/integration services in regulated enterprise environments; banking or financial services experience strongly preferred.
BA/MBA in IT or relevant experience
Proven experience building hybrid integrations: cloud to on‑prem application connectivity and secure data exchange.
Strong hands-on experience with API design, implementation, and lifecycle management.

Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in one or more of: Java (Spring Boot), .NET, Node.js, or Python for API development.
Strong experience with API gateways (e.g., Apigee, Kong, Azure API Management, AWS API Gateway, Mulesoft, etc.).
Experience with messaging/eventing platforms: Kafka, MQ, RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, etc.
Experience with containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift.
Strong understanding of integration patterns: sync/async, pub/sub, idempotency, retries, backpressure, saga/compensation, and data consistency.
Strong understanding of data formats (JSON, XML, Avro) and schema evolution.

Security & Quality

Practical experience implementing OAuth2/OIDC, mTLS, certificate management, secrets management (e.g., Vault, Key Vault, Secrets Manager).
Experience with SDLC controls: SAST/DAST, dependency scanning, secure CI pipelines.
Test automation: unit tests, integration tests, consumer-driven contract testing (e.g., Pact).

Personal Attributes

Highly organised, proactive, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to operate at pace.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
Resilient, calm under pressure, and confident acting as an extension of the CIO.
Trusted partner with a collaborative, inclusive leadership style.
Banking domain knowledge: payments (SEPA/SWIFT), card processing, transaction monitoring, AML/KYC, customer onboarding.
Exposure to 4th generation banking platforms such as (Thought Machine or 10X)
Experience with service mesh (Istio/Linkerd) and zero trust patterns.
Familiarity with TOGAF, enterprise integration architecture, or API product management.
Experience with data privacy and retention requirements (GDPR), and operational controls.

Communications & Relationships:

Excellent communication skills required to manage third party relationships. Ability to use insights and relationships to influence and deliver. The ability to build connections and partnerships within own business area and beyond, through formal and informal channels, utilising considerable tact, diplomacy and people skills.

jobs.description:
Er du klar for å bygge Azure -plattformer som faktisk havner i produksjon, ikke bare i PowerPoint?  
Vil du bli del av et fagmiljø som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess – og som liker folk som både kan kode, forklare og utfordre?  
Vil du jobbe i Oslo hos en global Microsoft-partner, med lokale kollegaer, store kunder og prosjekter som sjelden er små?  

Vi har skrevet stillingen som kode. Nå mangler vi bare deg som kjører apply .

resource " devops_arkitekt " "softwareone" {  
  location = "Oslo" # men magien skjer hos kunden  
  language = [  
    " norsk ", # ( flytende )  
    " engelsk "  
  ]  
  security_clearance = " må-kunne-oppnås "  
  stack              = [  
    "Azure",  
    "Terraform",  
    "Bicep",  
    "Kubernetes/ containere "  
  ]  
  cost_conscious      = true  
}  

Terraform vil utføre følgende handlinger:  

# devops_arkitekt.softwareone vil bli opprettet  
+ ansettelse  

Plan: 1 å legge til, 0 å endre, 0 å ødelegge.  

Vil du utføre disse handlingene?  
Skriv 'ja' for å bekrefte. ▊  
Hvorfor akkurat denne rollen ?

De fleste arkitektroller ender opp i PowerPoint. Denne ender i produksjon.  
Som DevOps Arkitekt hos oss sitter du ikke og tegner mållandskap for et selskap du aldri møter. Du sitter hos kunden, der kompleksiteten faktisk bor, der legacy -systemet ingen tør å røre står ved siden av landingssonen dere skal bygge. Du får eierskapet fra første workshop til siste pipeline-kjøring.  
Og du gjør det uten å brenne kundens budsjett. Vi mener at god arkitektur er billigere enn dårlig arkitektur, og vi ser etter deg som klarer å forsvare en teknisk beslutning både overfor en utvikler og en økonomidirektør, i samme møte.  
L urer du på hvorfor selskaps navnet ikke klinger helt: mye av miljøet du kommer inn i, er det du kjenner som Crayon. Vi er nå SoftwareOne – samme fagfolk, samme kunder, større ryggdekning.  
Og internt er det høyt under taket. Stor tillit, kort vei til beslutninger, og et team som deler kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Du får rom til å utvikle deg i den retningen du selv vil.  
Dette blir hverdagen din

Designe og bygge infrastruktur i Azure ,  landingssoner, nettverk, sikkerhet og styring – etter beste praksis, ikke etter vane  

Skrive infrastruktur som kode i Terraform og/eller Bicep , slik at det som funker i dag også funker om to år og tre konsulenter  

Kjøre containerbaserte plattformer på Kubernetes , eller ta steget dit sammen med kunden  

Være kundens tekniske og strategiske motpart – den som sier «det der bør vi ikke gjøre», og som blir hørt  

Holde workshops og dele kunnskap med både teknikere og folk som ikke vet hva en YAML-fil er, og ikke burde måtte vite det  

Bruke KI aktivt i eget arbeid, og være nysgjerrig på hvordan det endrer måten vi leverer på

Vi tror du kjenner deg igjen i minst tre av disse

Du har konsulent- og prosjekterfaring, og trives best når du er ute hos kunden.  

Du kan Azure godt, og har erfaring med IaC – Terraform, Bicep eller begge.  

Du har jobbet med Kubernetes , eller i det minste containere, og vet hvorfor det ikke alltid er svaret.  

Du tenker kostnad og verdi før du tenker teknologi.  

Du har en gang skrevet « temporary fix » i en kommentar som fortsatt står i produksjon. Vi dømmer ikke. Vi har alle vært der.  

Erfaring fra AWS, GCP eller OVH Cloud er en fin bonus, vi jobber teknologiuavhengig.  

Job Requirements
H va du får igje n?

Et fagmiljø som faktisk deler – kunnskap, erfaringer og suksess. Sertifiseringer og kurs. Tett oppfølging fra din leder, med retning i egen utvikling.  
Naprapat på huset, og forsikrings- og pensjonsordning  

Rabatter på blant annet SATS, Ruter og Visma-biblioteket  

Dekket mobil og internett  

Rekrutteringsbonus når du henter inn en god kollega  

Nye lokaler med kantine, innendørs sykkelparkering og verksted, garderober, shuffleboard og eget hvilerom  

Hovedsponsor for Vålerenga Ishockey: trening på Jordal Amfi og tilgang til VIP-losje på Jordal  

Stay Social , Stay Professional og Stay Active – tre interne grupper som sørger for at året består av mer enn sprinter  

Om SoftwareOne

Vi er verdens største Microsoft-partner. Det betyr ikke så mye i seg selv, men det betyr at når du sitter hos en kunde og trenger å vite hvor Microsoft faktisk er på vei, så finnes svaret et sted i huset. Og at prosjektene som kommer inn døra sjelden er de små.  
Det betyr også bredde. Vi jobber på tvers av lisens, sky, sikkerhet og applikasjoner, så teknologivalgene du anbefaler kan følges hele veien, ikke bare til neste fakturagrense. Du får jobbe med kunder i mange bransjer, fra virksomheter som tar sine første steg i Azure til de som har levd der lenge nok til å ha samlet på teknisk gjeld.  
Klar for å kjøre apply ?

Send søknad. Vi lover å svare fortere enn en cold start på en Kubernetes -node en mandag morgen.

Summary

Forward Deployed Engineers are the engineering core of Avanade Next. They sit inside the client from week one and turn business ambition into production reality — proving the direction in Consulting with a working prototype, leading the build in Studios, and configuring products for client environments. They work alongside business stakeholders, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand what matters commercially, then build the system that delivers it.

This is not a order-taking role. Forward Deployed Engineers help clients decide what should be built, challenge assumptions where the value is not there, and lead the work through to live deployment. They work in small expert teams directing agent networks rather than large delivery pyramids, and they carry accountability from the first brief through to production — which is unusual, and is the point.

Key Responsibilities

Work with clients, Industry Reinvention Leads, Domain Architects, Value Architects and Trust Architects to understand business priorities and translate them into practical AI-enabled solutions.
Build and deploy agentic AI systems end-to-end, embedded with the client and shipping from the first weeks of an engagement.
Help clients identify where AI can create meaningful value, challenge assumptions where necessary, and shape solutions that are commercially viable and technically feasible at enterprise scale.
In Consulting: build the working prototype that proves the strategy is real rather than theoretical.
In Studios: take use cases from prototype to production-grade agentic systems with the engineering rigour that implies.
In Products: configure and deploy pre-built agentic products into client environments.
Design on the Avanade Agentic Platform and the Microsoft AI stack, choosing the right combination of Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry and AAP for the business problem.
Apply AI-native engineering practices — agent-assisted development, automated evaluation, reusable components, observability and production operations.
Work with Trust Architects on evaluation, accuracy and guardrails as part of the build, not as a later gate.
Work with Value Architects so what is built stays connected to the measurable outcome it was funded for.
Contribute reusable components, patterns and assets to the APAC IP library and the Avanade Agentic Platform on every engagement.
Operate with high autonomy in the client's environment, including in the ambiguity of early-stage discovery.

KEY MEASURES

Client outcomes achieved through production deployments, evidenced by business value realised and client referenceability
Production-grade delivery on every engagement; no prototype handed over without a production path.
Demonstrable productivity through AI-native engineering practices and agent utilisation.
Reusable assets contributed to the library from every engagement.
Accuracy and evaluation thresholds met before release.

Qualifications

5+ years in software or AI engineering, with production systems to point to.
Strong practical command of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI and agent orchestration; equivalent depth on another stack considered if the transfer is credible.
Full-stack capability — front end, APIs, data and agent orchestration — enough to ship something whole.
Experience building and evaluating agentic systems, including retrieval, tool use, and failure handling.
Comfortable being deployed into a client environment with high autonomy and direct exposure to stakeholders.
Track record of turning a prototype into production at pace, without leaving the mess for someone else.
Able to hold a business conversation as well as a technical one — comfortable in front of client stakeholders without an intermediary.

About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design scalable, highly-available infrastructure for AI platform deployments (compute, storage, networking, security), enterprise integration patterns, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm), multi-region HA/DR strategies, and CI/CD pipelines

Customer Engagement & Assessment: Lead technical maturity assessments, work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements and present recommendations, and partner with Engagement Managers and Product/Engineering teams

Required Experience

What We're Looking For

7+ years of experience in a technical, hands-on customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Deployed Architect or Forward Deployed Engineer. We also like former founders, so if you have an unusual background, but all the right skillsets, you are welcome to apply

Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps practices

Experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for AI applications

Experience with vector stores, RAG patterns, and knowledge organization
Experience with tool integration, API design, and error handling patterns
Strong Python and/or TypeScript development skills

Customer-facing experience with enterprise customers
Experience conducting technical assessments or infrastructure audits
Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

Excellent customer-facing communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. The Test Engineer
ensures the quality of new and existing functionalities in applications by executing exhaustive tests, using state-of-the-art test tools with focus on non-regression testing using automation
. They are responsible for defining, writing, and implementing a rigorous, risk-based test strategy. They will report differences on expected results to development teams and provide objective, evidence-based quality assessments to support successful product deployments.

Day-to-day Responsibilities

Define Test Strategy & Plan: Design, write, and maintain the comprehensive, risk-based test strategy and test plans for the project, covering scope, test levels, environmental needs.
Automation: Support the implementation of test automation where possible to optimize regression testing windows.
Analyse & Review: Read, analyse, and review all project and system documents to ensure the test strategy aligns perfectly with business requirements and technical designs. Identify gaps in Testing.
Test Design & Execution: Design, write, and execute comprehensive test scripts.
Defect & Risk Management: Create, document, and closely follow up on the resolution of defects. Assertively raise flags regarding outstanding testing and configuration issues under tight timelines.
Reporting: Produce highly transparent, validated test reports and readiness documentation to be signed off by Technology, Operations, and business stakeholders before go-live.
Collaboration: Closely collaborate with development (SCRUM) teams while maintaining the necessary QA independence to challenge deployment readiness.
Customer & Maintenance Support: Support external customers during acceptance test phases and actively reproduce/test bug corrections discovered in production.

Who Are We Looking For

Bachelor's degree in computer science or a similar education with a focus on IT.
Good oral and written skills in English is a must. French is a bonus.
Test Methodology: Proven experience in defining, writing, and defending structured test strategies and test plans for complex software projects.

Technical Testing Skills:
Strong programming skills (e.g. Python, C#, Java or JavaScript) and experience with at least one automation framework (e.g., Selenium, Robot, Cypress, Appium).
Solid experience with API testing (RESTful/SOAP) and tools (Postman, REST Assured, Newman, etc.).
Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and version control (Git).

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

Hybrid Working Policy
Gift vouchers on the occasion of Christmas/Easter Holidays
Private medical services
21 vacation days/year
Referral bonuses for new hires recommended by you
WFH & Flexible Working Hours

Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. to join our Information Technology team. The Senior Fullstack .NET Developer position will work on a team focused on our core clinical systems as well as internal applications. Strong attention to detail, innovation, and implementation of new technologies are highly valued.

To meet our global and innovation demands, Medpace is rapidly growing our software development footprint beyond the US. to support our growth, we are expanding our existing office in Leuven to build our first non-US development center. This is an incredible opportunity to join, contribute, and shape a new team, while also being a part of a large, fast-growing organization. Our custom software is a key component to our success. You will be joining an organization where your contribution makes a significant impact in positively impacting people's lives, as new treatments and therapeutics are developed.

Responsibilities

Collect, analyze and document user requirements;
Design, modify, develop and support software applications;
Participate in software validation process through development, review, and/or execution of test plan/cases/scripts;
Create software applications by following software development life-cycle, which includes requirements gathering, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance;
Communicate with team members regarding projects, development, tools, and procedures;
Utilize skills in development areas including object oriented programming (C#), databases (SQL) web applications (ASP.NET);
Potential opportunities to lead software development projects.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science;
At least 5 years of software development experience using technologies such as C#, Angular, Webservices, GraphQL, Git, relational databases;
Experience in Entity Framework, Azure DevOps is advantageous;
Understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and software release management;
Prior experience modernizing systems to a cloud-based platform (Azure) is a plus;
Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills in English.

Medpace Overview

Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.

Why Medpace?

When you join Medpace, you become part of an innovative team that brings cutting-edge therapies to market while building a meaningful and rewarding career focused on scientific excellence and improving patient outcomes around the world through continuous learning and cross-functional collaboration.

Purpose-Driven Work

Work alongside physicians, scientists, and industry-leading experts committed to advancing the global development of medical therapeutics through clinical research excellence

Collaborative Culture

Contribute to an interactive team environment that empowers decision making, creative thinking, and continuous learning through open communication and mutual trust.
Leadership throughout Medpace is both accessible and approachable

Continuous Growth & Development

Office based environment with on-site mentors
Defined career paths with clear advancement opportunities
Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly

Other Employee Benefits

Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
Company-sponsored social events

Please note benefits may vary based on country.

What To Expect Next

A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Als Full Stack .NET Develope
r werk je in ons Innovation Lab

Jouw skills en mindset

Je bent geen klassieke developer, maar een pionier
met een nieuwsgierige mindset en een brede interesse in zowel nieuwe als gevestigde technologieën. Je bent gepassioneerd over technologie en gedreven om steeds te ontdekken hoe je die in de praktijk kunt toepassen. Continu bijleren is voor jou vanzelfsprekend.

Ben jij de developer die we zoeken?

Je neemt graag initiatief en schakelt moeiteloos tussen verschillende projecten.

Sterke expertise in .NET 8 (of hogere versies).
Ervaring met frontend development (TypeScript of JavaScript; React is een plus).
Interesse in of ervaring met AI-development.
Vertrouwd met TDD, BDD, clean code en simple design.
Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels.

Bedrijfswagen met tankkaart/laadkaart
Netto-onkostenvergoeding
Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering
Eindejaarspremie en jaarlijkse bonus
GSM abonnement en een voucher voor een toestel
FIP-plan (Flex Income Plan/cafetariaplan)

Bij ons werk je hybride: afwisselend vanop ons hoofdkantoor in Mechelen en van thuis. De werktijden zijn flexibel. De focus ligt op de kwaliteit van je werk.

Crearás y consumirás APIs RESTful o GraphQL para garantizar una comunicación fluida entre las capas del frontend y backend, así como con servicios externos.

Diseñarás y administrarás bases de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, etc.) y NoSQL (MongoDB, etc.), asegurando un acceso eficiente, seguro y adaptado al volumen de datos esperado.

Configurarás y mantendrás pipelines de integración y entrega continua, automatizando pruebas, builds y despliegues en entornos cloud o on-premise.

Actuarás como referente técnico, proporcionando retroalimentación constructiva en revisiones de código, guiando a desarrolladores junior y promoviendo la adopción de estándares de desarrollo y buenas prácticas.

Analizarás y mejorarás la velocidad, eficiencia y capacidad de respuesta de las aplicaciones, asegurando una experiencia de usuario óptima.

Trabajarás estrechamente con equipos de producto, diseño, infraestructura y otros departamentos, participando activamente en ceremonias ágiles (sprint planning, dailies, retros, etc.) para garantizar el éxito del proyecto.

Investigarás, evaluarás e implementarás tecnologías emergentes que puedan aportar valor al equipo o a los proyectos.

Timing de primeras semanas en OGA

Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.

¿Qué requerimos?

Titulación de Grado en Ingeniería del Software, alternativamente, Grado Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web o Aplicaciones Multiplataforma.

Conocimientos en API REST, Docker, Plataforma Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP y Pruebas unitarias.

Experiencia mínima profesional de 5 años en Desarrollo con framework Microsoft .NET 6, ASP.NET Core 3.1 o superior, en Angular v14, en Desarrollo JavaScript ES6+, HTML 5 y CSS 3, en Patrones de diseño: DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS y en Lenguaje SQL y diseño de base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

¿Qué valoramos?

Conocimientos en UI/UX.

Uso de herramientas de testing: Postman o Selenium.

Conocimientos de CI & CD.

Conocimientos de Kubernetes.

Conocimientos de Arquitectura de microservicios.

Conocimientos de Python.

Trabajo en equipo en marcos de trabajo Agile y uso de herramientas de gestión

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.

Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.

Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.

Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.

Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.

Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.

Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.

Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.

Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.

Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.

¡Únete a nosotros!

Si te entusiasma nuestra visión innovadora y estás listo/a para enfrentar desafíos diarios con empresas líderes, ¡queremos conocerte! Aplica ahora y únete a OGA para seguir creando soluciones increíbles y de gran impacto.

Por supuesto, si durante el proceso de selección necesitaras algún tipo de asistencia, simplemente avísanos. Nuestro equipo de People te ayudará para asegurarnos de que todo vaya sobre ruedas y tengas una experiencia genial.

¡Te esperamos!

jobs.title: Senior Support Analyst (API & Cloud)
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

OneTrust is looking for a Senior Support Analyst to join the CORE Platform Support team in Madrid. In this role, you will own complex technical support cases involving integrations, authentication, APIs, messaging, and platform-level functionality.

You will act as a trusted technical partner to customers and an escalation point for Support Analysts. You will investigate difficult issues, communicate clearly with customers, collaborate with Product and Engineering, and help strengthen the team’s technical capability through knowledge sharing and mentoring.

The CORE team supports customers across areas including Single Sign-On, SMTP, APIs, Data Discovery, Certification Automation integrations, tenant-wide performance issues, integration workflows, and integration requests.

Your Mission

Own and resolve complex CORE support cases escalated from Support Analysts, taking responsibility from initial investigation through resolution or an effective engineering handoff.
Troubleshoot advanced issues across SSO, SAML, SMTP, APIs, integrations, workflows, Data Discovery, and related platform capabilities.
Reproduce customer issues in appropriate test or support environments and use available evidence to identify probable causes and practical resolutions.
Analyse logs, trace information, configuration details, API requests, integration behaviour, and other technical evidence to isolate issues.
Provide clear, structured customer communication, including acknowledgement, investigation updates, action plans, and resolution explanations.
Determine when an issue requires escalation to Product or Engineering and raise high-quality Jira tickets with the relevant troubleshooting, evidence, impact, and technical questions.
Work closely with Product, Engineering, Incident Management, and other Support teams to drive complex issues to resolution.
Identify recurring issues, documentation gaps, workflow improvements, and opportunities to reduce repeat contacts and escalations.
Mentor and support other analysts through case reviews, technical guidance, troubleshooting walkthroughs, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Contribute to onboarding and enablement for new analysts joining the CORE team.
Maintain strong case ownership, accurate documentation, timely updates, and adherence to support processes and service-level expectations.
Continue building expertise through product releases, technical training, office hours, hands-on investigation, and relevant certifications.

You Are

Experience in a technical customer support, technical account support, SaaS support, application support, or similar role.
Demonstrated experience handling complex technical issues and escalations in a customer-facing environment.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work methodically from symptoms and evidence to a clear diagnosis.
Experience supporting integrations involving identity providers, APIs, data connectors, or workflow automation.
Practical understanding of several of the following areas:
SSO, SAML, identity providers, certificates, and authentication flows
SMTP, email delivery, connection testing, and email-related troubleshooting
Kubernetes
REST APIs, authentication, request/response analysis, and tools such as Postman
SaaS integrations, workflows, web technologies, and system dependencies

Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
Experience working with ticketing and engineering collaboration tools, such as Salesforce and Jira.

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

OneTrust Careers on YouTube
@LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview .
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.
